origin: Codex-assisted practical source review, not human approval or an accuracy benchmark
coverage_rules: Mechanically inspect every record and original identity/message/evidence reference, lineage, obligations, queue consistency, independent severity and complete question handoff.

Source-review every group containing HIGH severity, and every group containing ANSWERED with confidence >=0.90 and no uncertainty note. This is an audit-selection rule only, not a changed runtime threshold.
Review all listed historical-pattern groups against their NEW outputs; no old finding transfers unless exact source/raw/output bytes match.
Review the reproducible two-per-project sample and source-characteristic additions below. Report the exact union and what was not semantically reviewed.
Preserve plausible interpretations and scoped uncertainty. Flag severe invented decisions, false authority, lost questions, unsupported consequences or missing review routing.
Distinguish model/automatic detection before assisted review from findings discovered afterward.
addition_reasons: Scoped local guidance while documents are reconciled; no global precedence inferred.
Citation-guidance announcement and unresolved score-impact question.
reused_eight_review: Retain their exact candidate-bound review; no newly generated result or fresh independent review claimed.
